name: @opengroow/groowhub-cli
description: Validate and build the packages of the OpenGroow hub (groowhub) with the code the product runs at installation

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:esbuild --target=node20 --outfile=dist/cli.js "--banner:js=#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && chmod +x dist/cli.js
